digest.component_or_area: CLI capability registry and optional dependency enforcement
propositions: A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must enumerate 14 immutable capability records, each mapping a semantic key to a packaging extra and typed missing posture (error/unavailable/abstain/fallback) without importing probe modules.
Command routing and top-level help must remain stable in a no-extras wheel; only selected execution boundaries after mode/backend selection emit actionable errors for error-posture capabilities.
Lean diagnostic/read/dry-run paths must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities (e.g., audit show without audit_ui, review diagnostics without agent_runtime).
Domain components for unavailable/abstain/fallback postures retain control of payloads and logging; the registry never manufactures their domain result.

The capability registry must validate structural integrity (all extras declared in pyproject, all referenced capabilities exist, no duplicate keys, no probe imports) and expose a shared error helper delegating from existing _optional.require_extra.
Separate entry points (rebar-mcp, review-bot) must consume capability metadata without appearing in the top-level CLI route registry.
